name: North Carolina
agency: North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles (NCDMV), NC Department of Transportation
permitAge: 15 (Level 1 limited learner permit, ages 15 to 17), after an approved driver education course of 30 classroom hours and 6 behind-the-wheel hours (handbook p. 12; G.S. 20-11)

teen.supervisedHours: 60 hours logged on the Level 1 permit, at least 10 at night (handbook p. 12; G.S. 20-11(d), max 10 hours per week counted). SL 2026-46 may change this; not reflected in the handbook or the statute page on 2026-10-09.
teen.holdPermit: 9 months on the Level 1 permit before Level 2 (handbook p. 12; G.S. 20-11(d)(1)); 6 months on Level 2 before Level 3 (p. 13)
teen.nightLimit: Level 1: first 6 months only 5 a.m. to 9 p.m. with a supervisor, then any time with a supervisor. Level 2: alone 5 a.m. to 9 p.m.; at other hours only with a supervisor, except driving directly to or from work or a volunteer fire, rescue or EMS activity (handbook pp. 12-13)
teen.passengerLimit: Level 2 without a supervisor: one passenger under 21 who is not a household member, plus one more under-21 student when driven directly to or from school; no limit if all passengers are household members; under-21 household members may not ride with under-21 non-household members (handbook p. 13)
teen.phone: Under 18: no mobile phone use while driving, hands-free included (G.S. 20-137.3), except emergency calls and calls to a parent, legal guardian or spouse (handbook pp. 12-13, 41). All drivers: no texting or email while driving (p. 41).

bac.under21: any amount of alcohol or drugs: one-year revocation (handbook p. 33; provisional licensees p. 14)

notes: Handbook checked 2026-10-09: NC Driver Handbook, back cover 'Revised May 2025', print run 09/25; PDF created 2026-04-22, modified 2026-09-10. Printed page = PDF page minus 2.
Knowledge test: the handbook (p. 10) and the NCDMV Driver License Tests page give no question count or pass mark; secondary sites disagree (25/20, 37/30). Left null.

Test languages: NCDMV Driver License Tests page says 'Tests offered in different languages' and oral tests on request, but lists no languages. Spanish handbook (Manual de Manejo) is published by NCDMV.
Traffic signs test is separate: identify signs by color and shape and explain meaning (handbook p. 10).
Supervising driver: parent, grandparent, guardian or responsible person approved by them; valid license held at least five years; seated beside the driver (handbook pp. 12-13; G.S. 20-11(c)(2)).
Level 3 full provisional removes the time, supervision and passenger limits of Levels 1 and 2 (handbook p. 13).

Driving Eligibility Certificate requirement reported eliminated effective October 1, 2026 (SL 2026-46); the handbook and the G.S. 20-11 page (amended through SL 2025-91) still show the older rules. Holding period and log rules are not used in questions.

School bus (handbook pp. 47-48; G.S. 20-217): two-lane, two-lane with center turn lane, and four-lane without median: all traffic stops; divided 4+ lanes with median, or 4+ lanes with center turn lane: only traffic following the bus stops.
Move Over Law (handbook p. 49; G.S. 20-157(f)): vehicle within 12 feet with warning lights: move to a lane not nearest it if 2+ lanes your way, else slow down and be prepared to stop.
Insurance minimums are 50/100/50 for policies issued or renewed from July 1, 2025 (G.S. 20-279.1(11), S.L. 2024-29); the May 2025 handbook p. 99 still shows 30/60/25 (checked 2026-10-10).
